matchingRule: Same state-listed thread/session ID, exact output token count, completion timestamps within 100 ms, one client response consumed once
intervalRule: [gateway.created_at - duration_ms, gateway.created_at]; overlaps across all threads merged for effectiveApiElapsedUs
included: Elapsed time of completed API requests, including their normal time to first token
excluded: 503/no-output failures, client retry backoff, cooldown, scheduler gaps, preparation, tool/Lean execution, ongoing calls, and upstream output lacking client completion confirmation
recordType: aggregate extract of existing API timing record
scope: same Q3 run before and after the runtime upgrade
